actName: Bihar Privileged Persons Homestead Tenancy Act
actNameHindi: बिहार विशेषाधिकार प्राप्त व्यक्ति गृहवास काश्तकारी अधिनियम
description: An Act to make better provisions for the homestead tenancy of privileged persons in rural areas of the State of Bihar.

sections.summary: Defines key terms like 'Building' and 'Privileged person' (a person holding no more than one acre of land other than their homestead).

sections.sectionTitle: Restoration of Possession of Privileged Tenant
sections.sectionTitleHindi: विशेषाधिकार प्राप्त काश्तकार के कब्जे की बहाली
sections.text: If a privileged tenant has been ejected by his landlord from his homestead or any part thereof otherwise than in accordance with the provisions of this Act, the Collector may, on his own motion or on an application made in this behalf, restore possession of the homestead to the privileged tenant.
sections.summary: Empowers the Collector to restore possession of a homestead to a privileged tenant who has been illegally evicted by their landlord.
Lists the specific grounds under which a privileged tenant can be legally ejected, such as non-payment of rent for two years or using the homestead for non-residential purposes.

sections.sectionTitle: Settlement of fair and equitable rent
sections.sectionTitleHindi: उचित और न्यायसंगत लगान का निर्धारण
sections.text: The Collector may, on his own motion or on application, settle fair and equitable rent in respect of any homestead held by a privileged tenant.
sections.summary: Allows the Collector to determine and fix a fair and equitable rent for the homestead.

sections.text: The State Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, make rules to carry out the purposes of this Act.
sections.summary: Grants the State Government the authority to formulate rules (like the BPPHT Rules, 1948) to implement the Act.
